To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
automatic formative assessment can positively influence engagement in Mathematics.

(i) engagement is a multidimensional construct that is related with motivation and learning; (ii) automatic formative assessment activities can promote engagement; (iii) the model proposed to design activities can positively influence engagement; and (iv) the model is particularly effective with students with low attitudes towards Mathematics.
automatic formative assessment can be an effective tool to increase engagement in Mathematics at middle school level.

the design and implementation of a model to promote engagement through computer-based activities with formative assessment and feedback, and with the evaluation of the effects of the proposed model in a school context.
